item.title: Beacon Pointe Advisors Acquires $1.4 Billion RIA Hemington Wealth Management
item.description: Beacon Pointe Advisors has acquired Hemington Wealth Management, a $1.2 billion female-founded registered investment advisory firm with offices in Falls Church, Virginia, and Chicago, Illinois. The deal marks Beacon Pointe’s fifth acquisition of a female-led firm this year and its twelfth overall in 2025. With Hemington joining the organization, Beacon Pointe’s assets under advisement rise to approximately $55 billion, further strengthening its position as the largest female-led RIA in the Unite

item.title: Cresset Adds $1.8 Billion Advisory Team In Strategic Expansion Across Atlanta And Jackson Hole
item.description: Cresset has expanded its national footprint by adding a high-profile advisory group overseeing more than $1.8 billion in client assets. The incoming team, led by Jamie Gilbert, Jean Wright, and Max Ripans, joins the firm from Goldman Sachs and will strengthen Cresset’s Atlanta operations while launching a new presence in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

item.title: Carson Group Onboards $1.45 Billion Total Wealth Planning Team
item.description: Carson Group has expanded its national advisory footprint with its most significant acquisition of the year through a strategic partnership with Ohio-based Total Wealth Planning, a 19-person firm overseeing approximately $1.45 billion in assets under management. The Cincinnati area team will rebrand as Carson Wealth and become the company’s 34th wholly owned office.

item.title: Palo Alto Networks: $3.35 Billion Acquisition Of Chronosphere To Advance AI Era Observability
item.description: Palo Alto Networks has unveiled a landmark plan to acquire Chronosphere for $3.35 billion, marking one of the most significant observability deals of the AI era. The company said the acquisition will enhance its ability to serve enterprises that increasingly depend on unified data, security, and real-time operational resilience as artificial intelligence workloads scale across global digital environments.

item.title: TAHO: $3.5 Million Seed Round Raised To Accelerate Distributed Compute Platform For Expanding AI Workloads
item.description: TAHO has secured a $3.5 million seed round to advance development of its distributed compute platform, designed to meet the rapidly expanding demands of artificial intelligence and high-performance computing. The company, founded by veterans of Meta, Google, and Snap, is building an infrastructure fabric that unifies cloud resources into a single intelligent environment capable of significantly increasing processing speeds while sharply reducing operating costs.

item.title: BVP Forge Raises $1 Billion For Second Fund To Accelerate Growth Investment Strategy
item.description: BVP Forge has secured $1 billion in capital commitments for its second fund, marking a significant expansion of the firm’s private equity platform and signaling continued investor confidence in its model of supporting growth-oriented, self-sustaining technology and services companies. The fund, named Forge II, was oversubscribed and closed in 4 months, bringing BVP Forge’s total assets under management to $2.3 billion.

item.title: KKR Expands Middle East Footprint With New Abu Dhabi Office In ADGM
item.description: KKR has announced the opening of a new office in Abu Dhabi within the Abu Dhabi Global Market, as the global investment firm continues to strengthen its long-term presence across the Middle East. The expansion marks another significant step in KKR’s regional growth strategy, as the United Arab Emirates continues to attract global capital and emerge as one of the world’s most dynamic financial and investment hubs.

item.title: MacKenzie Scott Donates Record $38 Million To Xavier University Of Louisiana
item.description: Xavier University of Louisiana has received a historic $38 million unrestricted donation from philanthropist MacKenzie Scott, marking the most significant private gift in the institution’s history. The contribution represents Scott’s second significant investment in Xavier after her $20 million gift in 2020, which recognized Xavier’s national significance as the only historically Black and Catholic university in the United States.

item.title: Grant Thornton UK Launches Major Partnership Expansion Following Cinven Investment
item.description: Grant Thornton UK has unveiled an ambitious plan to substantially grow its leadership ranks, announcing it will recruit 160 new partners over the next two years as part of a sweeping strategy to accelerate firmwide growth. The move marks one of the most significant partnership expansion initiatives in the UK professional services sector. It comes on the heels of the firm’s landmark transaction with global private equity firm Cinven.

item.title: DigitalBridge: $11.7 Billion Closed For Third Digital Infrastructure Fund
item.description: DigitalBridge Group has secured $11.7 billion in combined commitments for DigitalBridge Partners III, comprising $7.2 billion in fund commitments and $4.5 billion in LP co-investment commitments. The raise marks one of the firm’s most significant capital-raising milestones to date and positions the platform to meaningfully expand into infrastructure areas that support AI and hyperscale computing.
